name: DPM-Solver++ 2M (10 NFE) + CGAR
tagline: Use a fast 10-step ODE sampler, then apply Critic-Guided Action Refinement: trust-region gradient ascent on Q at inference, no extra NFEs.

key_hyperparams.name: cgar_trust_radius
key_hyperparams.role: L2 cap on deviation from diffusion sample

diff_from_baseline: On top of the DPM-Solver++ baseline (10 steps), adds an inference-only critic-guided refinement: 2 normalized gradient-ascent steps on Q with a small trust region around the original sampled action. Diffusion NFE budget is unchanged. Note this also touches the (officially non-editable) pipeline file.

name: Adaptive-NFE DPM-Solver++ (Q-uncertainty gated)
tagline: Default 10-step DPM-Solver++ 2M, plus an optional 5-step refinement triggered when Q's coefficient-of-variation across candidates exceeds 0.1.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces fixed-budget sampling with a two-pass adaptive scheme: cheap 10-NFE pass first, only re-sample with 15 NFE when the per-state Q-uncertainty across candidates is high, then keep the higher-Q action. Adds runtime spend only where the critic is uncertain.

name: DPM-Solver++ 2M (3 NFE) + Adam-on-action
tagline: Aggressive 3-step ODE sampler at inference, then 5 Adam updates on the action with respect to Q before candidate weighting.
init_recovers: DPM-Solver++ baseline (10 NFE) when refine_steps=0 and steps=10
diff_from_baseline: Pushes inference NFE to just 3 (vs. 10 for the DPM-Solver++ baseline) and compensates with twice as many candidates (100) plus 5 Adam steps of action-level Q-ascent. The policy/critic training steps are pinned to a 10-NFE DPM-Solver++ regardless of YAML.

name: DPM++ 2M + Conservative Q + Elite Refinement
tagline: 10-NFE DPM-Solver++; training adds clipped advantage + value-match losses; inference does uncertainty-weighted elite refinement and barycentric fusion.

key_hyperparams.name: elite_mix
key_hyperparams.role: barycentric mix between sampled and refined elite

init_recovers: DPM-Solver++ baseline when all extra weights=0 and refine_steps=0
diff_from_baseline: Beyond switching the YAML to DPM-Solver++ 2M (10 NFE) the agent rewrites training (adds clipped advantage-matching + L1 value-match losses on top of DQL) and inference (pessimistic-Q elite selection, refinement, barycentric fusion). Touches the officially non-editable pipeline file.

name: DPM-Solver++ 2M (10 NFE)
tagline: Pure config swap to a 10-step DPM-Solver++ 2M sampler; pipeline algorithm unchanged.
diff_from_baseline: Identical to the dpm_solver baseline (solver=ode_dpmsolver++_2M, 10 sampling steps). The agent makes no algorithmic change beyond the configured solver and step count.
